instructions: Call richview_learn before drafting. Read data and save or edit the report's .rmd with your host's file tools, in its own report folder. Run richview_validate and richview_check after edits, including the final edit. Inspect structuredContent.status and diagnostics: status clean means no errors or warnings; ok true means no errors, and isError describes whether the call could execute. Repair warnings and errors, check again, then richview_render and inspect the output against the brief. Publish only when asked. The user chooses RichView-hosted Cowork at https://app.richview.ai or their own server, and configures RICHVIEW_SERVER and its RICHVIEW_TOKEN in the MCP host before publishing.

tools.description: Upload a local data or media file to a configured S3-compatible store and return its integrity-pinned reference {url, bytes, sha256, type, visibility}. Private unless public is true. Calling again resumes an interrupted upload or reports the stored object. Progress notifications follow the request's progressToken.

public.description: Serve under the public prefix with immutable caching

type.description: Media type when the extension is ambiguous

tools.name: richview_asset_put

tools.description: Check a stored object against its reference: HEAD status, size, type and range support; with hash, stream the object and compare its SHA-256. Private references need store.

store.description: Store profile that signs requests for private references

tools.name: richview_asset_verify

tools.description: Renders the saved report and checks provenance and chart geometry: clipping, collisions and dropped labels. Read structuredContent.status and diagnostics, repair warnings/errors, and check again after the final edit. A report finding returns isError: false; status: clean means no warnings or errors. Same result as `richview check`.

chartWidth.description: Measure charts at this width in pixels instead of the widths readers get

inputPath.description: The report's .rmd or the folder holding it; a folder of report folders stands for every report below it, and the result then holds each report's own result in `reports`

styles.description: Styles (a builtin name or a file in the report folder) replacing the source's `styles` for this call

tools.name: richview_check

tools.description: Search Unsplash for photos. Returns candidates {id, description, author, author_url, width, height, color, thumb, regular, unsplash_url}. Show the user the photographer for each candidate and let them choose; searching does not register a download. Needs UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY in the server environment.
tools.name: richview_image_search

tools.description: Use a chosen Unsplash photo: registers the download with Unsplash once (as the API guidelines require) and returns ready-to-paste YAML in `yaml`, an `image` block or a `title_image` frontmatter mapping, with a hotlinked src, width, height, the photo's dominant `color` (#rrggbb, omitted if the API gives none) and a visible credit (Photo by <name> on Unsplash). Reports may hotlink only credited images.unsplash.com photos. Paste the YAML into the .rmd unchanged and never download or rehost the image. Call it only for a photo that will appear in the report, once per photo. If it fails during download tracking it returns an error without YAML; retrying is safe but may count the download twice.

alt.description: Alt text; defaults to the photo's description

tools.name: richview_image_use

tools.description: Returns RichView's authoring guide, or one section of it. Call this first. Same text as `richview learn`.
tools.name: richview_learn

tools.description: Publishes a version of the report to the named RichView server. The token comes from the host environment (RICHVIEW_TOKEN), never from arguments. Its result has slug, version, url, permalink and, from a hosted server, share: the report's page in the app, where people are named and who can open it is chosen. Same result as `richview publish`.

inputPath.description: The report's .rmd, saved in its own report folder, or that folder

new.description: Create a report address the server has not stored before

server.description: Server URL; defaults to RICHVIEW_SERVER and must equal it when that is set, so the token only goes to the configured server

tools.name: richview_publish

tools.description: Writes the self-contained HTML report, or a PDF printed by a local Chromium-family browser, into the report folder's Rendered/. Run richview_check after the final source edit for geometry and provenance findings before generating. Its result has ok, status, output (the file written) and the render diagnostics. Same result as `richview generate`.

inputPath.description: The report's .rmd or the folder holding it; a folder of report folders stands for every report below it, and the result then holds each report's own result in `reports`

outputName.description: File name inside Rendered/; a .pdf name implies pdf

styles.description: Styles (a builtin name or a file in the report folder) replacing the source's `styles` for this call

tools.name: richview_render

tools.description: Checks a report's structure and files without rendering it. With publish: true it adds the publish rules. Same result as `richview validate`.

inputPath.description: The report's .rmd or the folder holding it; a folder of report folders stands for every report below it, and the result then holds each report's own result in `reports`

publish.description: Also apply the publish rules: title, description, version and a valid slug

tools.name: richview_validate

resources.description: Reading this resource also returns its data/visits.csv companion; save both in the same report folder.
resources.name: Example: hello-world report.rmd
